acceptance_criteria: Pending-poll save and removal operations return typed outcomes that distinguish durable success, retryable failure, and terminal failure; callers do not inject or acknowledge success when persistence failed.
Pending-poll load failures remain distinguishable from an empty durable set and trigger an explicit degraded or unavailable recovery state instead of silently continuing from an empty array.

Current unresolved persistence obligations, oldest obligation age, retry state, and last failure are projected into runtime health; lifetime error totals remain diagnostic rather than the sole health signal.
Every pending-poll persistence mutation has an idempotent retry or reconciliation owner and a durable terminal disposition or tombstone that prevents ambiguous success.
Offline poll decisions are consumed by a recurring, leased worker with bounded backoff rather than a one-shot boot path.
One malformed or transiently failing queued decision cannot prevent later eligible decisions from being attempted, and retained rows carry a visible reason and next-attempt state.
Live and offline decisions share one lifecycle contract with durable receipts from accepted through applied, retrying, terminally rejected, or moot.
Focused tests inject save, removal, load, per-row processing, restart, and retry failures and prove truthful health, idempotent recovery, and no success-shaped side effects before durable success.
blast_radius: Agent poll recovery, poll result delivery, fleet approval decisions accepted while an instance is offline, runtime health truth, restart behavior, and operator recovery of retained poll obligations.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if exact main returned typed failure observations from pending-poll save, removal, and load operations; prevented success-shaped runtime effects before durable success; degraded health on current unresolved persistence obligations; or scheduled queued offline decisions for retry without a reboot. Exact source inspection disproved each condition. The 220 passing issue-relevant and control tests establish existing behavior, not the missing retry and lifecycle contract. This audit did not mutate production state, inject a live database failure, or measure fleet incidence, so operational frequency, retry policy, and alert thresholds remain implementation-time measurement obligations.
impact: A persistence failure can be represented to the runtime as success or as an empty durable set, leaving poll delivery and recovery state ambiguous while health remains green. Offline decisions can remain durable but unapplied until another reboot, and one thrown row can defer unrelated decisions behind it.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2539 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and every decisive path byte; reject integration on revision drift until the evidence is rerun.
Define one typed pending-poll persistence result contract and require every caller to branch explicitly on durable success, retryable failure, and terminal failure.
Prove that save, removal, and load failures cannot produce success-shaped interaction injection, resolution, deletion, or an empty-set interpretation.
Give offline decision consumption a recurring lease, bounded retry schedule, per-row isolation, idempotency key, and durable terminal or moot disposition.
Separate current obligation health from lifetime counters and verify recovery clears only the current warning while retaining cumulative evidence.

Add RED and GREEN tests for database save, removal, and load faults; malformed and transient queued rows; failure followed by a valid row; worker restart; lease expiry; duplicate delivery; and recovery.
Run all four decisive suites plus the broader durability and health controls against committed implementation bytes.

suggested_remediation: Introduce a shared typed persistence-result contract for pending polls and make runtime side effects conditional on durable success. Represent load failure separately from an empty durable set, persist current retry obligations and terminal dispositions, and derive health from unresolved work rather than cumulative errors alone. Replace the boot-only offline decision loop with a leased recurring consumer that processes rows independently, uses idempotency keys and bounded backoff, and records accepted, applied, retrying, moot, and terminal receipts through one lifecycle used by live and offline decisions.
